userFacing.summary: One-step updater rollback: every update snapshots the previous version and its settings first, Help › Roll Back to Mark… restores the snapshot together with the settings it had before the update, and the version being left is skipped until a newer release ships; if an update breaks startup the same restore runs from the terminal before the UI boots (mark --rollback, --yes for scripts). A failed snapshot cancels the update with a clear notice, the fresh snapshot promotes only after the new version actually boots (staging-to-live at next-boot reconcile), the Windows restore verifies the previous installer's minisignature from that release's feed against the pinned public key (two network requests; macOS restore fully offline), a concurrent mark --rollback delegates to the running app's confirmation, and the App Store edition exposes no rollback surface; M-068/V-M-068 route the new mt-rollback module.
